items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I heard – who did I hear there in the early 60s, like Lennie Tristano or somebody you know. I just happened to be in town.

ctx.x: Oh he told stories about him and Zoot at the Half Note in New York. I was only at that club once and I heard – who did I hear there in the early 60s, like Lennie Tristano or somebody you know. I just happened to be in town. And it was a funny kind of a club that I think you walked in and you walked around the bar but the bandstand was above the bar. So the guys, the bartenders would be beneath you. So they had this thing worked out where he and Zoot and the bartender, this character, would give them drinks and…
